text:
Platinum Price in 2001
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2001, the LBMA platinum price fell 20.5% between 2001-01-31 ($604) and 2001-12-28 ($480). The highest sampled price was $610 in February and the lowest was $423 in October. The mean of these observations was $519. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
